summary: preinstall hook fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (pinned to v1.3.13) and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')],...)` to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` blob heavily obfuscated with a rotated string/const array (`WV8StW` shift routine over a large `n7gIxM` mixed hex/string table) and mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `WV8StW`, `MmgoCP`). Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque, obfuscated payload outside Node's toolchain is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; it bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners and runs attacker-chosen code on the installer's machine on `npm install`. This behavior is unrelated to the stated purpose of a feature-flag SDK wrapper, and the obfuscation actively resists inspection of what the payload does.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
